headline: Fierce Clashes Shake Central Fronts as Island Sectors Settle
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, frontline volatility has shifted heavily back to the contested mainland sectors while island theaters have quieted down, with Colonials completing their consolidation of Godcrofts into full control. Weathered Expanse and Stlican Shelf stand as the fiercest flashpoints on the map, logging eleven and eight base ownership transitions respectively over the past two hours, with Stlican Shelf leaving one strongpoint contested as no-man's-land. Linn of Mercy has erupted into renewed base warfare with five recent transitions alongside nearly nineteen hundred casualties in two hours. Direct clashes also persisted in Stonecradle and Callahan's Passage, each posting three base events in the latest two-hour interval, centered on local footholds like The Cord and The Latch. Fishermans Row witnessed late swings leaving a base neutral, while Viper Pit registered a sharp, sudden acceleration in casualties without immediate line shifts.
